name: @dsh-chamber/dsh-chamber-client-ui-open-in
description: Chamber-bundled open-in client plugin (designs 16/20 + Batch 3 unification): one header entry over the per-source view-model — the page-level machine catalog (installed apps and their real icons, read once from the local instance) plus the source's launch carrier (the machine host domain, or the desktop main-process VS Code provider for a remote SSH target). This package also hosts the conversation stream-health seat (design 14 §D4): the chamber's recovery arm for a journal the official stack latches into 'error' (a concrete per-session resync, evidence-gated and budgeted) plus the 20 s/90 s loading dwell notices. A parked 'loading' open is re-issued by the renderer's page-level delivery ladder, whose open-stall evidence (openInFlight === false) caps at its bounded resync tier
